# FDG4034

> DO use an enum to strongly type parameters, properties, and return values that represent sets of values.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.8 Enum Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Whether a parameter, property or return value represents a set of values is a design judgment; not machine-checkable.
